blocks.text: WASHINGTON, United States — Has MAGA fever finally broken? Will the American right shed Donald Trump’s populist ideology and return to more traditional conservatism? After a resounding defeat in midterm elections that were all about one man, many Republicans on Wednesday are questioning the party’s future — and the role, if any, of President Trump in shaping it. The Wall Street Journal, whose opinion pages are the standard-bearer of the establishment right, has demanded “soul-searching” and called for a break with the ultranationalist, identity-based rhetoric that fueled the octogenarian’s rise to power. “Tariffs and mass deportation are no substitute for rising […]...
